positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer on the NCR Omni-Channel Decision Support Platform (ODSP), an open platform that will provide cloud-based foundational and micro services, allowing for cross-industry business opportunities and innovation.
Works with architects, product managers, and development team to design and implement several services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead of the NCR Engage white-label iOS app, focused on providing an easily brand-able, highly configurable solution that empowers NCR's consumers to engage with their consumers.  The Engage App feature set includes:

• Online Ordering
• Loyalty Programs
• Gift Card Support
• Customer Voice (Customer feedback using Net Promoter Score)

In order to continue growing the Engage Mobile solution, was responsible for working with various stakeholders: project managers, UI/UX designers, and other product teams (internal and external to NCR) to design and implement new app features.  

Apps published include: Wendy’s, Krispy Kreme, KFC Australia, Buffalo Wild Wings, Chick-fil- A, Which Wich, Tom & Eddies.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Developed PIC microcontroller software for guitar pedal effect and designed accompanying analog hardware.

positions.description: Computer hardware and software diagnostics and repair.
